For a 2BHK Hyderabad repaint, I’d compare the three strongest organised options this way. Prices below are current public prices, but the final quote can change after inspection.

Provider	Likely total cost	Extra/exclusions to watch	Cancellation	Warranty/support
Urban Company	₹17,999 unfurnished / ₹22,499 furnished	Upgrades, repairs and some specialised work can add cost. Package covers 2 bedrooms, living room, kitchen + 2 bathrooms. 
Urban Company
	35% upfront; refundable until 24h before start. Later cancellation: ₹1,000 fee. 
Urban Company
	Relationship Manager + WhatsApp escalation; final inspection. Warranty should be confirmed for the exact package.
NoBroker	₹18–42/sq ft; final quote after inspection	Major cracks/damp treatment, heavy furniture/appliances, electrical/plumbing and custom textures are excluded unless separately quoted. 
NoBroker
	Advertises free cancellation/rescheduling. 
NoBroker
	1-year chipping/bubbling warranty + ₹10,000 damage insurance; project management and cleanup included. 
NoBroker

Asian Paints Beautiful Homes	Quote after ₹250 refundable inspection	Exact prep/material scope depends on selected plan and quotation.	Confirm cancellation/refund terms on the quote before paying.	Platinum includes supervision, mechanised tools, technical evaluation, professional cleaning and 1-year service + applicable product warranty in Hyderabad. 
Asian Paints

What matters for total cost: don't compare ₹/sq-ft alone. Get each quote to explicitly state putty, crack filling, primer, number of coats, paint brand/grade, masking, furniture movement, cleanup, GST and warranty exclusions.

For a normal furnished 2BHK, ₹20k–₹30k+ is a sensible comparison band; substantial wall repairs or premium paint can push it higher.
